S, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
CORAM: THE HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE J.M.KHAZI  ORAL ORDER (PER: THE HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE J.M.KHAZI)
1.

Petitioner who is arranged as accused No.3 has filed this petition under Section 482 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (for short, 'the BNSS Act') to grant him anticipatory bail in Crime No.43/2024 of Haveri woman Police Station, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376, 376(2)(n) and 342, 109 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code (for short, 'the IPC').
2.
In support of the petition, the petitioner has contended that he is innocent and law abiding citizen.
He has not committed any offences.
There is no nexus between him and alleged crime.
Petitioner is taxi driver and drives the taxi of one Mahantesh Walikar.
No offences as alleged have taken place.
There is no prima facie material to connect the petitioner with the crime.

He is the NC:
2024:KHC-D:16383 permanent resident of the address given in the cause title.
He is ready and willing to abide by any conditions that may be imposed.
Accused No.2, 4 and 5 with similar allegations are already granted anticipatory bail and pray to allow the petition.

3. On the other hand, learned HCGP submitted oral objections stating that after conducting detailed investigation, charge sheet came to be filed against accused Nos.1 to 5 alleging offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n), 342, 109, r/w 34 of the IPC and Section 4, 6, 12, 17, and 21 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (for short, 'the POCSO Act').

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is alleged that at the time of complaint, the prosecturix was aged 17 years 11 months 29 days and a minor.

Despite knowing that prosecturix is minor, since about 3 years prior to the filing of the complaint, accused No.1 used contact her over phone and on 09.7.2023 and 13.02.2024 took here to the room situated in the land of accused No.2 and committed rape on her.

On 16.06.2024 at 9.00 p.m. he took the prosecturix from Sri.Basaveshwar NC: 2024:KHC-D:16383 Temple of Karjagi village in the Swift Dzire Car No.KA-27/- C-2918 belonging to accused No.3 to the house of CW.9 situated in Ranebennur and stayed there.

sentences.text: He has also taken the prosecturix to the house of accused Nos.4 and 5 and committed rape on her.
On 19.06.2024 accused No.1 took the prosecturix to Sri.Satyanarayanswami Temple, Hanagal and in the presence CWs-10 to 13 married her by tying a yellow thread with dried turmeric root.
Allegation against accused No.2 is that he allowed accused No.1 to stay in a room belonging to him and failed to inform the Police.
The allegations against petitioner/accused No.3 is that he allowed the accused No.1 to travel with the prosecturix in his Car.
From the date of complaint, the petitioner has absconded.
The allegations made against him are grave and pray to dismiss the petition.

5. Heard arguments and perused the records.
6.

The allegations against the accused persons are that, even though as on 19.06.2024, the prosecturix was a major i.e. aged 18 years, on which day accused No.1 NC: 2024:KHC-D:16383 married her in the presence of CWs.10 to 13, since 3 years prior to it, during her minority he had sexually assaulted her on 09.07.2023, 13.02.2024 and 18.06.2024.
During all this period the other accused helped him.
7. The petitioner is driver by profession.
The allegations against him is that he allowed the accused No.1 and prosecturix to travel in his Car on 16.06.2024 despite knowing that she was a minor.
Already accused Nos.2, 4 and 5 with similar allegations are granted anticipatory bail in Crime No.43/2024.
Already charge sheet is filed.
Having regard to the nature of the allegations made by the petitioner, his custodial presence is not required.

For the above reasons, this Court is of the considered opinion that petitioner is also entitled for anticipatory bail and accordingly, the following:
ORDER Petition is allowed.

Petitioner/accused No.3 shall be released on bail, in the event of his arrest in Crime No.43/2024 of Haveri woman Police Station, registered for the offences NC: 2024:KHC-D:16383 punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376,
376(2)(n) and 342, 109 read with Section 34 of the IPC, subject to following:
CONDITIONS a) The petitioner/accused No.3 shall execute a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
with two sureties for the like-sum.
b) He shall appear before the investigating officer within a period of 15 days and execute the bail bond and offer surety.

c) Petitioner/accused No.3 shall make himself available for the purpose of investigation as and when required and he shall co-operate with the investigation.
d) Petitioner/accused No.3 shall furnish his residential address proof and shall inform the investigating officer/Court if there is any change in the address.
